detail.purpose: Regular finding prose and report evidence at 14px.

motion.name: control-color-transition
motion.value: background-color .14s ease-out, border-color .14s ease-out, color .14s ease-out
motion.purpose: Applied only when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference; report changes have no entrance motion.

focus.purpose: Global keyboard focus; search input locally uses a 1px outline offset.

provenance.approvalBoundary: User explicitly chose glass styling for this trial on codex/scram-glass-preview. Detailed implementation is recorded, not claimed separately approved. Production codex/scram-usability is unchanged. No approved image comp.
provenance.tonalRampNote: Preview-only OKLCH ramps synthesized from each extracted color at eight stepped lightness values. They are not implemented CSS tokens or approved palette additions.
provenance.componentNote: Self-contained source-derived samples use fallback values when project custom properties are unavailable. Package data is illustrative. Samples do not execute the viewer application.
provenance.readabilityUpdate: Approved readability/usability extension, retaining the dependency registry world. Final CSS overrides define effective sizes. Native how-to details, file drop zone, filter refinements and export disclosure are implemented. Four verified synthetic examples; optional CLI report serving stays on loopback.
provenance.correctedReference: User explicitly requested matching the supplied 21st adjustable-glass-dashboard behavior after rejecting the first trial. Scenery, independent opacity/tint wash and a live material sample now reflect the reference; production remains unchanged.

layout.narrowGrids: Two columns for examples, summary facts and refinements

appearance.scope: Trial branch codex/scram-glass-preview only; production codex/scram-usability unchanged.
appearance.controls: Native details; four bounded ranges and one hex color input; three presets, reset and close. Session-only, report data unchanged.
appearance.fallbacks: Solid preset, unsupported backdrop-filter and reduced transparency use #18212b without blur/transparency. Forced colors uses Canvas/CanvasText and removes gradient/shadows; preference modes disable appearance controls.

scenery.purpose: Local room image from the supplied reference provides real scenery behind backdrop-filter; no pre-blurring.

liveSample.material: Same tint wash, material, filter and edge variables as the outer surfaces. Solid mode is opaque and unblurred.

appearance.solidDifference: Solid intentionally remains opacity 1 / blur 0, rather than the supplied reference’s 86% preset, for a true opaque accessibility fallback.

narrative.overview:
This document describes the styling trial on `codex/scram-glass-preview` only. Production remains on `codex/scram-usability` and is unchanged. The user explicitly chose to apply the supplied adjustable-glass styling to the existing viewer; this is authorization for the trial, not approval to replace production. There is no approved image comp.

The existing dependency registry now sits inside a floating frosted header, rail and workspace over the reference room photograph (`web/assets/glass-room.jpg`). Fixed viewport scenery and a dark shade supply visible detail for the actual backdrop blur; the photograph is not pre-blurred. Inner evidence panels stay quiet and unblurred. Sora, Manrope, amber selection and explicit policy/severity semantics retain their established roles. `web/glass.css`, loaded after `web/styles.css`, owns this trial's overrides; `web/glass.mjs` controls session-only material settings. The corrected trial follows the supplied 21st adjustable-glass-dashboard reference. It adds the local reference room image while retaining native HTML/CSS/JavaScript, without a framework migration or new dependency.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent dark outer surfaces, illuminated edges and quiet inner evidence panels.
Amber selection and focus, with explicit status words alongside status colors.
Readable tabular report facts and wrapping identifiers.
A report chooser, inventory and inspector that stack as space narrows.
Immediate report-state changes, optional short control transitions and adjustable session-only glass.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Preserve the visible policy, severity and example labels when using status color; a dot or color alone does not carry the result.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for actual identifiers, versions where represented as code, and commands; retain Manrope for human explanations.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep inner evidence legible with quiet translucent fills and fine rules; reserve backdrop blur and ambient lift for the outer workspace surfaces.

dos: **Do** use this branch’s frosted outer frame, quiet inner evidence, fine rules and existing Sora/Manrope pairing.
**Do** keep provenance, policy explanations and missing-evidence warnings visible before interpreting scores.
**Do** pair semantic colors with explicit words and preserve the amber keyboard focus outline.
**Do** preserve identifier wrapping, responsive stacking and local table overflow.
**Do** keep selected report and selected dependency states distinguishable from policy outcomes.
donts: **Don't** turn a passed policy or zero known findings into a visual claim of repository safety.
**Don't** replace unknown baseline values with zeros or successful status decoration.
**Don't** treat this styling trial as production approval or claim an approved image comp.
**Don't** add decorative graph data, artificial live activity or entrance motion to this saved-report registry.
